about: module board's domain, memory-store, sqlite-store, and import-boundary mutants; each is killed by a canonical law or test of modules/board.

mutants.name: board-grant-allows-denied-channel
mutants.to: out = if r.Deny { AllPermissions() } else { r.Allow }
mutants.rule: An explicit deny grant rule closes access to the matched channel pattern rather than granting permissions.

mutants.name: board-secret-scanner-skips-aws
mutants.rule: ScanSecret detects every supported credential shape including AWS access keys.

mutants.name: board-mentions-reads-code-span
mutants.rule: SettleMentions ignores @handles inside inline and fenced code spans.

mutants.name: board-idempotency-ignores-digest
mutants.rule: Reusing an idempotency key within 24 hours with a different payload fails IdempotencyConflict.

mutants.name: board-apply-drops-reaction
mutants.to:
case ReactionChanged as p:
		let _ = p
		next
mutants.rule: Apply folds ReactionChanged events into the message's projected Reactions map.

mutants.name: board-memory-skips-expected-check
mutants.rule: Store.Commit fails StalePosition and changes nothing when expected does not match the board head.

mutants.name: board-search-leaks-private-channel
mutants.rule: Store.Search never returns messages from a channel the caller cannot read.

mutants.name: board-task-skips-fence-check
mutants.from: t.State == TaskClaimed && t.HasClaim && token > 0 && token == t.Epoch && now < t.Claim.LeaseUntil
mutants.to: t.State == TaskClaimed && t.HasClaim && token > 0 && now < t.Claim.LeaseUntil
mutants.rule: Holder task operations require the current claim epoch token so a stalled worker cannot settle another worker's claim.

mutants.name: board-task-claim-ignores-ready
mutants.from:
case TaskReady:
		case TaskClaimed:
			return TaskClaimedRefusal
mutants.rule: ClaimTask succeeds only while the task is ready, ensuring at most one winner in a claim race.

mutants.name: board-task-reopen-completed
mutants.rule: Completed tasks are final and cannot be reopened to complete a second time.

mutants.name: board-task-skips-trust-set
mutants.rule: ClaimTask refuses with TaskOwnerUntrusted whenever the task owner is outside the claimer's trust set.

mutants.name: board-task-plan-allows-cycle
mutants.rule: CreatePlan refuses any prerequisite graph containing a cycle with InvalidNeeds.

mutants.name: board-task-plan-allows-oversized
mutants.rule: CreatePlan refuses plans exceeding 15 tasks with PlanTooLarge.

mutants.name: board-task-prereq-readies-on-incomplete
mutants.rule: Completing one prerequisite readies a waiting dependent only when every other prerequisite is also completed.

mutants.name: board-sqlite-skips-expected-check
mutants.rule: sqlite.Store.Commit checks the board head against expected inside BEGIN IMMEDIATE and fails StalePosition without mutating state.

mutants.name: board-sqlite-drops-projection-update
mutants.rule: sqlite.Store.Commit updates projection tables inside the same transaction as event append so Snapshot agrees with Fold.

mutants.name: board-sqlite-bypasses-schema-fence
mutants.rule: sqlite.Open refuses databases carrying an unknown or newer schema_version cleanly with StoreFailed.

mutants.name: board-sqlite-fts-skips-index
mutants.rule: Posting a non-deleted message populates messages_fts inside the same transaction so FTS5 Search returns matching hits.

mutants.name: board-sqlite-disables-import-guard
mutants.rule: CheckStorageImportBoundary catches forbidden sql or modules/sqlite imports outside sqlite/ and cmd/board/.

mutants.name: board-api-skips-data-sentence-check
mutants.rule: CheckToolDescriptions requires every generated MCP tool description to end with the mandatory spec section 5.1 data sentence.

mutants.name: board-api-skips-profile-input-guard
mutants.rule: CheckSchemaForbidsAsAndProfile catches any MCP tool schema exposing an input named as or profile.

mutants.name: board-api-claim-untrusted-flag
mutants.rule: TasksClaim marks the claimed task view trusted: true after trust-set verification while read/list views remain trusted: false.

mutants.name: board-api-unauth-wrong-exit-code
mutants.rule: CliPolicy maps Unauthenticated to exit status 3 per spec section 6.

mutants.name: board-api-read-leaks-private-channel
mutants.rule: Read refuses private channels the caller cannot read with NotFound.
